name: cond_pnorm
expr: c1 = cond(A, 1); c2 = cond(A, 2); cInf = cond(A, Inf); cFro = cond(A, 'fro');
comment: Sig: c = cond(A, p) for p ∈ {1, 2, Inf, 'fro'}. Closes the ⚠️ gap in PROGRESS where cond was 2-norm only. p=2 routes through cond_2norm (sigma_max/sigma_min); other p via norm(A,p)·norm(inv(A),p). Diagonal A = diag(1, 1e-3) gives exactly 1e3 for p=1,2,Inf and slightly above for 'fro' (sqrt(1+1e-6) · sqrt(1+1e6) ≈ 1e3 + 0.5e-3).
